THE WHOLE PLATFORM, IN VIEW

More than filling a shift.

Explore the full feature scope described in your platform guides and landing-page concepts.

01Rosters, shifts & availability10 capabilities+
  • Multi-store weekly roster builder
  • Recurring shift templates and conflict detection
  • Five-tier shift escalation
  • Active, confirmed and historical shifts
  • Shift interest, acceptance and manager approval
  • Shift descriptions, duties and pharmacy software requirements
  • Recurring availability, leave requests and blackout periods
  • Cross-store staff floating and favourite locums
  • Location-aware urgent shift notifications
  • Task calendar, recurrence, reminders and completion tracking
02Talent, onboarding & reputation6 capabilities+
  • Public shift board and public talent profiles
  • Filters for location, date, rate and software proficiency
  • Travel, accommodation, flexible, urgent and negotiable shift preferences
  • QR codes, invite links and pharmacy membership onboarding
  • Two-sided ratings and workplace reviews
  • Profile specialisations and published availability
03Invoicing & administration6 capabilities+
  • Award-rate calculation workflow
  • Penalty-rate and state public-holiday handling
  • PDF invoice generation with GST and ABN details
  • Invoice preview and sending
  • Unpaid, pending and paid invoice tracking
  • Invoice history and financial audit trail
04Pharmacy Hub & communication7 capabilities+
  • Shift-linked direct messages
  • Pharmacy and organisation group channels
  • Announcements, clinical updates and operational notices
  • Community polls, comments and reactions
  • Work notes and structured shift handovers
  • Community feed, posts and professional networking
  • Live message and shift notifications
05Organisations, access & verification8 capabilities+
  • Multi-pharmacy owner and organisation dashboards
  • ABN lookup, pharmacy claiming and store hierarchy
  • Delegated roster, staff and communication managers
  • Membership applications and access permissions
  • Cross-location shift, member and financial overview
  • AHPRA registration verification workflow
  • Compliance vault for police checks, CPR and inductions
  • Role-based access across web and mobile
06Rewards, learning & every role8 capabilities+
  • Pill loyalty points for shifts and engagement
  • Pharmacist and pharmacy referral rewards
  • Bronze, Silver and Gold reward progression
  • Pill redemption towards eligible platform credits
  • Owner, pharmacist, manager and other-staff workspaces
  • Organisation administration and Explorer community
  • Talent Hub and learning materials
  • CPD-aligned Learning Hub — coming in the reference roadmap

Feature scope from the supplied product references. Live availability, verification automation, reward terms and rate calculations require product confirmation before launch. Learning Hub is marked as upcoming; this preview does not activate these services.

A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Let’s clear things up.

Getting started should feel simple.

Who is ChemistTasker for?

ChemistTasker brings together pharmacy owners, pharmacists, pharmacy assistants, technicians, other staff and organisations. Each role has a workspace suited to its needs.

Can I manage more than one pharmacy?

The owner workspace includes multi-pharmacy management, so you can organise pharmacy locations and their teams from one account.

How do I find a shift or find talent?

Choose Find a Shift to open the public shift board, or Find Talent to explore the public talent board. Account registration may be required to apply or connect.

Can my pharmacy staff use it too?

Yes. Other staff have their own dashboard, including roster, availability, memberships, chat and Pharmacy Hub access according to their role and permissions.

Where can I see pricing?

Visit the pricing page for the current plans and subscription details. You can access it from the navigation or footer.
